reason: Paying cash at my door on the first order is the only reason I'd try it, since I don't pay anything to a name I don't know. I'd order one car part or phone accessory I can't find in Shorja and see if it really shows up at the quoted price.
objection: 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item is a lot. For most electronics, the shops and Instagram pages here are close enough on price that I'd rather walk in and get it today than wait three weeks. And after the first order I have to pay up front again.
